newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 364-day t-bill average yield 6.365 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 364-day t-bill average yield 6.365 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.365 percent at its auction of 364-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 364-day treasury bills on June 5 for a similar amount, the average yield was 6.459 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.375/347 percent against 6.469/449 percent previously.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 182-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on June 26.
